Lower Text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, it may unsuspend.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may hatch in your breeding area. Then, 1 of your Digimon with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits in the breeding area may digivolve into a level 5 or lower Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits in the hand without paying the cost.
